name: Intervals.icu Running Stats
description: Year-to-date running distance, time, average pace and run count from your Intervals.icu account
author: Diogo

athlete_id.title: Intervals.icu Athlete ID
athlete_id.description: Your athlete id, e.g. i1234567. You can also just use "0", which always means "the account this API key belongs to".

api_key.title: Intervals.icu API Key
api_key.description: Generate this at intervals.icu under Settings > Developer Settings

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to re-fetch stats from Intervals.icu

env_vars.name: INTERVALS_ATHLETE_ID
env_vars.description: Intervals.icu athlete id, e.g. i1234567 or 0 for yourself (fallback if not set in the web UI)

env_vars.name: INTERVALS_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Intervals.icu API key from Settings > Developer Settings (fallback if not set in the web UI)
